provenance.note: this OpenOCD build prints the CMSIS-DAP probe serial as `serial=<id>` on its interface line

notes: Venue B: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350) on a bench host, console on the board's USB CDC port, flash and read-back through a Raspberry Pi Debug Probe with OpenOCD. `deployment` is the instance prefix fth puts before the plan's command names. No `boot_event`: the plan commands `version.VERSION`, so no version event is logged once per boot only; a reboot shows as an FSW-time backstep. Relative paths only: run from the campaign root on the bench host, which holds `zref/` (this repository, built). `serial` is the debug probe's USB serial.
